EU.name: EU
EU.headline: Since July, every parcel pays. From November, it pays twice.
EU.dek: A €3 duty per product category, then a handling fee: the EU customs reform lands on every low-value shipment, and platforms become the importer of record.

expos.name: LogiMAT 2026
points: Record edition: 1,671 exhibitors and 69,856 visitors from 46 countries.
Humanoid robotics was the standout trend on the warehouse floor.

expos.name: WMX Europe 2026
points: A session on the end of EU de minimis brought together IPC, PostNL, the UPU and Zonos.
Attendees singled out customs and data as the strongest theme of the event.

coming.what: EU handling fee on parcels under €150 due to apply. The Commission proposes €2, pending the objection period.
New EU Customs Authority in Lille expected to start operating.

UK.name: UK
UK.headline: The £135 import loophole now has a closing date.
UK.dek: Low-value import relief will be removed by October 2028, and Royal Mail is reshaping its universal service before this Christmas.

expos.name: Parcel+Post Expo 2026
points: Nova Post named Service Provider of the Year; Swiss Post’s AI robotic singulation won Sorting Technology.
Keynote panels with InPost, Omniva and JD.com on the next decade of parcel networks.

expos.name: The Delivery Conference 2026
points: Organised by Metapack and ShipStation around AI-driven “intelligent delivery”.
Cross-border and sustainability on the programme.

coming.what: Autumn Budget. The law removing the £135 relief is expected in the Finance Bill.
Royal Mail universal service reform fully rolled out.

NA.name: NORTH AMERICA
NA.headline: The $800 free pass is gone. Clearance is now part of the product.
NA.dek: De minimis suspended since June, a statutory repeal in July 2027, and tariffs rebuilt after court rulings: US inbound parcels run on new rules.

expos.name: Manifest 2026
points: More than 40 product launches, from AI orchestration platforms to tariff-calculation tools.
Warehouse robotics took a large share of the floor.

expos.name: MODEX 2026
points: Record 50,000 registrants from 132 countries and 1,057 exhibitors.
ProMat 2027 dates announced for Chicago.

coming.what: US midterm elections, with tariffs a key voter issue.
NRF Retail’s Big Show, New York.
Statutory repeal of the US de minimis exemption takes effect; USMCA annual joint review.

SA.name: SOUTH AMERICA
SA.headline: Brazil scraps its 20% tax on parcels under $50.
SA.dek: The “taxa das blusinhas” is gone, a new federal VAT on small imports is planned for 2027, and the country votes in October.

expos.name: Fórum E-Commerce Brasil 2026
points: 62,000+ visitors. Anjun Express launched with 41 hubs and 600,000 parcels a day.
LATAM Cargo reported e-commerce transit times down 31% in the first half.

expos.name: Intermodal South America 2026
points: First expanded Interlog Summit, focused on ports and transport corridors.
Carriers including MSC and Hapag-Lloyd exhibited.

coming.what: Brazil general election, first round (run-off 25 Oct).
Brazil implementing rules after the end of the 20% import tax up to US$50 (law signed 10 Sep).
New federal VAT (CBS) to apply to small imports; rate still to be confirmed.

AS.name: ASIA
AS.headline: ASEAN is writing one rulebook for digital trade.
AS.dek: The ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement, covering cross-border e-commerce and payments, is due to be signed in Manila in November.

expos.name: DELIVER Asia 2026
points: 315 retail and supply chain leaders and 930 pre-booked meetings.
Retailer-voted awards for Kardex and DP World.

expos.name: transport logistic + air cargo SEA
points: Emirates SkyCargo launched a weekly freighter to Bangkok.
SATS unveiled its “Hub Handler of the Future” programme.

coming.what: ASEAN Summit in Manila; signing of the digital economy agreement targeted.
Japan plans to end the ¥10,000 consumption-tax exemption on low-value imports.

CN.name: CHINA
CN.headline: Shenzhen hosts APEC as the West closes the small-parcel door.
CN.dek: Chinese platforms move stock closer to buyers while Beijing drafts new powers to protect them abroad.

expos.name: CCBEC Shenzhen 2026
points: 1,500+ exhibitors, with AliExpress, Amazon, Lazada, Shopee and TikTok Shop.
China’s cross-border e-commerce trade reached about RMB 618.5bn in Q1 2026.

expos.name: LogiMAT China 2026
points: Theme: reshaping intralogistics with AI, with a dedicated AI + logistics zone.
Buyer matchmaking with Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia.

coming.what: China International Logistics and Supply Chain Fair, Shenzhen (dates to confirm).
Revised E-Commerce Law extending rules to logistics and payment providers.

ME.name: MIDDLE EAST
ME.headline: Saudi Arabia plans 42 logistics hubs. 25 already run.
ME.dek: E-commerce logistics in the Kingdom is projected to double by 2027, while Gulf states tighten VAT on imports and move to e-invoicing.

expos.name: Seamless Middle East 2026
points: 25,000+ participants, with Home Delivery World ME co-located.
Arab Digital Economy Index 2026 launched: UAE first, Saudi Arabia second.

expos.name: Saudi Warehousing & Logistics Expo
points: 18,000+ professionals expected and 300+ exhibitors.
25 of 42 planned logistics hubs already operational.

coming.what: UAE: large businesses must appoint an e-invoicing service provider.

NAF.name: NORTH AFRICA
NAF.headline: Casablanca hosts Africa’s logistics sector twice this year.
NAF.dek: Logismed in May, LogiTerre in October, and new customs systems in Egypt and Tunisia reshaping how parcels are declared and taxed.

expos.name: Logismed 2026
points: Spain as guest country, with 27 companies.
E-commerce logistics, AI and decarbonisation on the programme, plus a startup award.

expos.name: International Maritime Expo 2026
points: Second edition, on ports of the future and intermodal links.
Organised by World Trade Center Algiers.

coming.what: Morocco: the new majority debates the 2027 budget after the 23 September elections.
